Jordan — thanks for the plan and the attachments. Quick answers inline:  

- Peak profile: attached (hawk_peak_profile.csv). Our 95th percentile concurrent requests sit at ~280 QPS with median prompt length ~320 tokens and a small tail of long-context sessions (~1.5% > 2k tokens).
- Latency sensitivity: about 45% of calls are “interactive” (<=120ms requirement), mostly search-summary and single-turn chat. The rest are asynchronous batch scoring (can tolerate 400–800ms).
- Compliance: we need VPC w/ customer-managed KMS; SOC2 evidence will be requested during procurement.

We prefer a staged cutover: staging with 5% live traffic, then 25% for 48h, then final switch. Targeting late June for final go-live.

One additional ask — can you provide the acceptance test checklist you use for GPU staging runs (latency, throughput, and token-accuracy checks)?

Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted→Dedicated: onboarding checkpoints, sizing validation, and SLA gates

TL;DR — this is doable within the June window with the following notes and constraints.

Sizing assumptions (preliminary):
- Interactive workload (45% of 280 QPS = ~126 QPS) — target p95 latency <=120ms. Recommend fleet composed of A100-80GB-equivalent instances using quantized 4-bit weights where feasible. Estimated steady-state: 8 nodes with 4x service instances per node (sustained), plus 2 spare nodes for capacity headroom (10 total).
- Batch workload (~154 QPS equivalent) — can be handled with the same pool using background batching and larger sequence-efficiency kernels.
- Long-context tail (1.5% sessions) — route to instances with extended KV memory; plan for burstable memory reservations on 2 nodes.

Staging & acceptance tests I recommend we include in the runbook (we'll produce a doc):
- Latency SLA tests: synthetic p95 tests for interactive prompts at target token lengths (100, 320, 800, 2048).
- Throughput stress: 1h soak at 1.25x expected peak QPS with mixed token distribution (measure token/s, GPU utilization, mem pressure).
- Regression quality check: run a 200-sample prompt set and confirm top-1 generation fidelity (BLEU/ROUGE as proxy + manual spot-checks).
- Failover verify: deliberately kill one node and measure auto-routing/fallback time.

Procurement/ops notes:
- Need KMS integration window (2 business days) and firewall/VPC peering coordination.
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide the standard package; Marissa should lead.

I'll draft a sizing spreadsheet (node counts, instance types, storage, estimated monthly GPU hours) by Thu morning (Jun 6). If we want faster latency than 120ms p95 for interactive, we'd need to up the node count or optimize model variants (add distilled low-latency variant).

—Ben
